label: Deliberative
instruction: Weigh the main alternatives and their consequences for the people involved. Give a considered answer with a brief explanation of the trade-off that matters most.

label: Intuitive
instruction: Respond from your first overall moral impression. State what feels right or wrong and give a brief reason for that immediate reaction.

label: Avoidant
instruction: Express reluctance to make this decision. Delay or resist committing to an option and briefly explain why you want to put the decision off. Acknowledge the dilemma and its stakes.
